name: Ostkustleden Etapp 6, Stjärneberg - Lilla Laxemar
description: Stjärneberg to Lilla Laxemar. Check current trail, access and service notices before departure.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Official title/text says Stjärneberg to Lilla Laxemar, but Naturkartan GPX/API geometry is stored Lilla Laxemar to Stjärneberg.
Naturkartan says 18.4 km, PDF/Oskarshamn/OSM/Pacer about 18.5 km, Döderhult about 19 km, computed GPX 18.407 km.

Etapp 5 originally recorded a closure/arsenic notice, but Etapp 6 official/facility/rules lanes and a direct follow-up check of current Naturkartan/Döderhult/Oskarshamn pages on 2026-04-29 did not reproduce visible closure or arsenic wording.
Sydsverige 2025 says water was fetched from a neighbor in buckets, while current Naturkartan says summer water line on yard and winter water from yellow slaughter shed.
Etapp 6 route description says the trail reaches Tjustgölen, while the Tjustgöl reserve page says the reserve lacks trails/paths and parking.
Timing note: No official section-specific walking time found. Naturkartan API time is null.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Stjärneberg
facilities.description: Shared Etapp 5/6 endpoint cabin cluster with two-room cabin plus smaller cabin, electricity, hotplate, iron stove/fireplace, dry toilet, woodshed and well about 75 m away. Current official/facility/rules passes and follow-up caveat-resolution check found no visible current closure notice; Check availability before user-facing claims.

facilities.name: Parkering Stjärneberg
facilities.description: Free parking by the Etapp 5/6 cabin, only two spaces; if full, use Klintemåla. Do not block roads/properties.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Laxemar
facilities.description: Etapp 6/7 endpoint cabin with kitchen, large common room, upstairs rooms, electricity, wood stoves, simple kitchen equipment, summer water line on yard, winter water in yellow slaughter shed, woodshed and simple dry toilet in outbuilding. No outdoor fires. Tent fee allowed at cabin.

facilities.name: Klintemåla guest harbour / Valborgs area
facilities.description: Off-route coastal/service access with toilet, shower, laundry, electricity, freshwater, fuel, groceries, environmental station, trailer ramp and canoe jetty.
